passage:
Coach Lin carried a small notebook during basketball practice. Players thought it contained secret plans.
One day, a player saw the pages. They were not full of game strategies. They were full of small notes: "Jason passes better under pressure," "Ming needs encouragement after mistakes," and "Team gets tired after twenty minutes."
The coach said winning required knowing people, not only plays.
After that, players paid more attention to one another. They noticed who needed help, who was quiet, and who worked hard without praise.
The notebook taught them that a team is not only a group wearing the same uniform. It is a group of people who must be understood.
